# KBD Constraints — Charcoal Agent

Generated by `/kbd-init` on 2026-09-23. The project has no `AGENTS.md` "Never Do"
section, so the blocking rules below are the generic KBD defaults adapted to this
stack (Vite/React/TypeScript + Tauri shell) plus rules derived from `CLAUDE.md`.

Commands use `npm` (Dockerfile builds with `npm ci`; `package-lock.json` is the
authoritative lockfile). No mandatory command wrapper or `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` policy
is defined for this project.

Path ownership: `.claude/`, `.agents/`, `.opencode/`, `.kimi-code/` and `openspec/`
are repository-owned tool configuration (OpenSpec skills/commands), not disposable
state — do not delete or regenerate them as part of a change. Reference workspace
folders (see `project.json` → `workspace.folders`) are read-only.

---

## Blocking Constraints (prevent archiving until resolved)

```yaml
constraints:
  - id: build-passes
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Vite production build must pass'
    command: 'npm run build'

  - id: tests-pass
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Vitest suite must pass (skills-sync integration test self-skips without a UAR)'
    command: 'npm test'

  - id: no-console-log-in-commits
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No console.log in committed TypeScript (console.error/warn for real error paths is allowed)'
    check: "grep -rn 'console\\.log' src/ --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx'"

  - id: no-any-type
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No new `: any` in TypeScript source (1 pre-existing occurrence at init; do not add more)'
    check: "grep -rn ': any' src/ --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx'"

  - id: no-hardcoded-secrets
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No hardcoded API keys/tokens; UAR auth comes only from VITE_UAR_API_KEY'
    check: "grep -rn 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]\\{8,\\}\\|Bearer [A-Za-z0-9]\\{16,\\}' src/"

  - id: no-env-files-committed
    severity: blocking
    description: '.env and .env.*.local must never be committed (only .env.example)'
    check: "git ls-files | grep -E '^\\.env($|\\.)' | grep -v '^\\.env\\.example$'"

  - id: reference-folders-read-only
    severity: blocking
    description: 'No writes to reference workspace folders (UAR, artifact-refiner, openfang)'
    note: 'Changes to the UAR contract are made in that repo separately; this project only consumes it'

  - id: pglite-migrations-append-only
    severity: blocking
    description: 'Existing entries in MIGRATIONS (src/lib/db/pglite.ts) must not be edited; add a new version instead'
    note: 'Review git diff of src/lib/db/pglite.ts'

  - id: pglite-not-prebundled
    severity: blocking
    description: '@electric-sql/pglite must remain in vite.config.ts optimizeDeps.exclude'
    check: "grep -q 'exclude: \\[\"@electric-sql/pglite\"\\]' vite.config.ts || echo MISSING"
```

---

## Warning Constraints (acknowledge before archiving)

```yaml
constraints:
  - id: no-lint-warnings
    severity: warning
    description: 'ESLint clean'
    command: 'npm run lint'

  - id: agui-contract-parity
    severity: warning
    description: 'New/changed AG-UI event handling in use-message-stream.ts matches UAR src/uar/api/sse.rs'
    note: 'Cross-check against the reference folder; flows are type → store action → stream case → render component'

  - id: assistant-ui-metadata
    severity: warning
    description: 'Every ThreadMessageLike produced in use-chat-runtime.ts carries metadata (and user messages attachments: [])'
    note: 'Manual review — missing fields crash @assistant-ui/react internals'

  - id: shadcn-components
    severity: warning
    description: 'UI uses shadcn/ui components from src/components/ui rather than raw HTML controls'

  - id: tests-for-new-features
    severity: warning
    description: 'Tests exist for new hooks, stores and utilities added in this change'

  - id: no-stub-comments
    severity: warning
    description: 'No TODO/FIXME/STUB/HACK comments in committed code'
    check: "grep -rn 'TODO\\|FIXME\\|STUB\\|HACK' src/"

  - id: accessibility-basics
    severity: warning
    description: 'New UI components have aria-label or semantic HTML'
    note: 'Manual review required'
```

## Workflow Triggers

```yaml
workflow_triggers:
  - event: on_iteration_complete
    action:
      type: command
      target: 'npm run build'

  - event: on_change_complete
    action:
      type: command
      target: 'npm test && npm run lint'

  - event: on_refinement_complete
    action:
      type: command
      target: "git add -A && git commit -m 'kbd: refine <change-id>'"
```

## Why

The conversation surfaces still use the pre-rebrand treatment, and the rest of the app is now Flat 2.0. A scan of `src/features/chat`, `src/components/assistant-ui` and `src/features/artifacts` (~2,950 lines) finds ~163 borders, shadows, blur, sub-12px sizes and raw palette colours. Some of these block users today:

- **Light-theme user message is unreadable.** It uses `bg-zinc-800` fill with `text-foreground`, so light text sits on a dark fill in dark mode and dark text sits on a dark fill in light mode.
- **Content blocks fail axe contrast.** They use opacity-dimmed text (`text-primary/70`, `text-muted-foreground/70`) and 9–11px mono metadata.
- **The 320px layout breaks.** The context-update block overflows horizontally and tool names truncate with no way to read the full name.
- **The A2UI input misstates its state.** It shows "Response captured" as soon as the tool call's stream completes, before the user has answered.
- **Mermaid artifacts sometimes show as source text.** The markdown path renders diagrams, but the artifact path does not route `mermaid` to the diagram renderer.
- **The composer is a blurred, outlined box.** It uses `border border-input`, `backdrop-blur-xs` and a focus ring halo, and shell captures show an ember outline around it.

The binding KnowMe UI/UX standard forbids all of this: §3 (Flat 2.0), §4.2 (12px floor) and §7.5/§7.7 (conversation event presentation and chat visual treatment).

## What Changes

- **Messages.** Assistant replies become unbubbled authored prose on the canvas, set in the long-form body face (Roboto) and kept to a readable width. User messages become an ember-tinted fill (`ember-soft`) on the trailing edge. The raw-palette user avatar is replaced with tokens.
- **Composer.** The composer becomes a filled surface with no border, no blur and no outline box. Focus shows as a change in fill, and the ember outline is removed.
- **Reasoning and sources.** Thinking/reasoning and citation blocks use cyan-tinted flat surfaces.
- **Tool activity.** Tool call, memory, skill and context-update blocks use surface/raised tokens. Their metadata is mono and at least 12px, and status uses status tokens with a text label.
- **Code and artifacts.** Code blocks use the brand code background. Artifact, HTML-artifact and A2UI cards are borderless. The HTML-artifact preview backdrop uses a token instead of `bg-white`, and the full-screen overlay uses the scrim token instead of blur.
- **Streaming.** The streaming cursor and the thinking pulse use cyan.
- **Behaviour fixes.**
  - A2UI shows "Response captured" only after a response is sent or received.
  - Mermaid artifacts render as diagrams, with a source fallback when rendering fails.
  - Tool names and context-update content wrap at 320px.
- **Guard.** The Flat 2.0 guard test extends to the chat and artifact files, adding checks for hex values, `bg-white` and opacity-dimmed text.

## Capabilities

### New Capabilities
- `chat-surfaces`: visual treatment and state honesty of the conversation thread, composer, streamed content blocks and artifacts under Flat 2.0.

### Modified Capabilities
None. `chat-layout` (bounded width, wrapping) and `chat-stream-rendering` (every block shown, reload) keep their requirements. This change restyles within them.

## Impact

- **Code:** `src/components/assistant-ui/{enhanced-thread,enhanced-markdown-text}.tsx`, `src/features/chat/components/*`, `src/features/artifacts/*`, one new token in `src/styles/tokens.css`, `src/test/flat-shell.test.ts`, new e2e checks under `e2e/`.
- **Docs:** `docs/design/chat-surfaces.md` (new).
- **Data and APIs:** no changes. Message storage, AG-UI parsing and UAR calls are untouched.
- **Not covered here:**
  - `attachment.tsx` semantics, which belong to assistant-ui-latest.
  - The activity/event inspector (§7.5), a separate feature.
  - Pages outside the thread, which belong to app-pages-flat2-entity-views.
